items.title: Billy Bauer interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: And everybody came there, like Milt Hinton, Bobby Hackett, Clark Terry, all of them, Zoot, Al, they all came.

ctx.x: That was like school for you.

Oh, you can’t buy that. Even sitting in, that’s what they’re trying to do, but it isn’t as regular as that. You know like and generally it would wind up to be a lot of cutting, you know, this guy plays this. And this place I ran, I had noted, my theme song was “No Sitting In at the Sherwood Inn.” Well I mean Friday and Saturday, and every night I had a different band. Like I had a different drummer, different bass player, and whatever the horn player was. And everybody came there, like Milt Hinton, Bobby Hackett,…
And this was where? At the Sherwood Inn?
